scope_limits: Physics runtime is explicitly pinned to game12f6cb0. Latest game main26e7f2a4 was audited, not substituted into this experimental consumer; current formal game integration and presentation equivalence remain unverified.

Only one small fork/rejoin-plus-ascent motif is lowered. R2 selects an abstract source cycle, but source point coordinates do not control the final physical layout; multi-Seed physical exploration variety is not established.
General Module assemblyInterface remains blocked by UNKNOWN general seams, transforms and state envelopes. Concrete whole-map observations do not grant universal per-module transfer guarantees.
Three scripted strategies and four sampled saw phases establish those exact policies only, not all player inputs, all phases, all entering resource states or a universal no-softlock theorem.

The first adapter supports enemy-free two-port bell ascents and one existing three-port fork. Arbitrary port shapes, reverse ascent requirements, difficulty targets and resource conditions are not a general solved constraint domain.
Quality diversity filtering reuses BehaviorArchive but this run has only one feasible behavior cell. It is not evidence of a broad, diverse or human-approved module library.

Difficulty intent and reward risk remain design targets; human difficulty scores, exploration fun, device performance and formal production approval are unverified. The 751.68wu flat connector is a visible pacing limitation.
Production promotion is guarded and explicitly rejected without human/interface evidence; no real production admission occurred.
This review does not sign off native video fidelity, public Web playability, public URL integrity, current wrapper scripts or final game feel. Those deliverable receipts must be reviewed separately.
The reviewer does not independently approve their own fill.py/synthesis implementation; another reviewer is required for that implementation scope.
overall_task_acceptance: Partial technical milestone accepted; full user delivery still requires the real playable artifact, full-map view, route videos, publication checks and separately scoped implementation review.
